name: Ollama
description: Ollama runs open models such as Llama, Qwen, Gemma and Mistral locally or on your own server.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Only needed when the server sits behind an authenticating proxy.

keepAlive.title: Keep alive
keepAlive.description: How long a model stays loaded after a request, e.g. 5m, 1h or -1m to keep it loaded. Defaults to the server's setting.

numCtx.title: Context length
numCtx.description: Context window (num_ctx) used for chat. Defaults to the model's setting.

think.title: Thinking
think.description: Reasoning before answering, for models that support it. low, medium and high only work on models that grade their effort, such as gpt-oss. Defaults to the model's setting.
